description: Download every file you can access in a course to local disk, up to max_files (default 50). Writes local files only; nothing changes in Canvas. Can take many requests and a lot of disk space; use download_file for one file.

content_types.description: Optional MIME types to include, e.g. ["application/pdf"]. Omit for every file.

course_id.description: Canvas course ID, a numeric string such as "12345". Get it from list_courses.

dest_dir.description: Local folder to save into. Defaults to the server's download folder (CANVAS_DOWNLOAD_DIR).

name: download_all_course_files
title: Download All Course Files
